title: Transport of an ordered stratum filtration through locally closed extension
statement: Let B be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], S and X Noetherian schemes, $a:S\to X$ an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], L any internal B_S-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and R a finite locally closed stratification of S with open prefixes [def-constructible-stratification]. There is a subobject filtration $F_0=\bot\le\cdots\le F_n=\top$ of the specified a_! L such that the cokernel of each successor inclusion is isomorphic to $(t_b\mathbin{\gg}a)_!t_b^*L$, where $t_b$ is the stratum immersion, using the closure-factorization extension [lem-sfb-coefficient-heart-locally-closed-extension]. No lisseness, constructibility, lattice, or scalar-map assumption is required.

proof.text: Use the open-prefix subobject construction and open-closed localization proof in the coefficient-heart filtration module. Its private openPrefix_filtration theorem applies to any module over a commutative condensed ring, without the specialized coefficient and constructibility hypotheses of the public wrapper.

source.place: Proof (1), stratified integral lattices and their extension-by-zero filtration

proof.text: For each representative monomorphism G_b -> L, form the represented subobject of a_! L after applying the exact additive functor a_!. It preserves monomorphisms, zero and isomorphisms, giving bottom and top endpoints. Functoriality maps every successor inclusion to a factorization of representatives. The cokernel-of-representatives isomorphism followed by preservation of cokernels identifies the quotient with a_! of the original quotient.

proof.text: Map the open-prefix quotient isomorphism through a_!, and compose with the internal locally closed extension composition theorem. This yields the displayed quotient on X. Repeated terms, empty strata and zero modules cause no difficulty.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_locallyClosedOrderedFiltration
    (B : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj B] [IsCommMonObj B] {S X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian X] (a : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion a]
    (L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj B S))
    (R : S.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification)
    (hR : ∀ b : Fin (R.n + 1),
      IsOpen (⋃ i : Fin R.n, ⋃ (_ : i.val < b.val), R.stratum i)) :
    ∃ F : Fin (R.n + 1) →
        Subobject ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension B a inferInstance).obj L),
      F 0 = ⊥ ∧ F (Fin.last R.n) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ h : ∀ b : Fin R.n, F b.castSucc ≤ F b.succ,
        ∀ b : Fin R.n,
          letI : IsImmersion (R.immersion b) := R.isImmersion b
          Nonempty (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (F b.castSucc) (F b.succ) (h b)) ≅
            (coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension B (R.immersion b ≫ a)
              inferInstance).obj ((CondensedRing.upperStar B (R.immersion b)).obj L))
